observations.seen: Meadow is flat and evenly lit with no clear key direction. Emberline has a warm sunset glow, but the foreground frog and grass sit in a dull, low-contrast midtone.
Vehicles and the frog have almost no readable contact shadows. Trucks and trams float on the asphalt, and the frog shows only a faint dark patch underneath.
Car paint has some baked glossy highlights from photo-scanned textures. Roads, water strips and logs show no environment reflection; the water is a flat blue band.
The world is a flat checker of grass, road, water and rail strips with sparse lollipop trees and blocky building silhouettes. Lily pads and logs are simple discs and half-cylinders.
Distance haze softens the far lanes in Meadow and Downtown. The sun disc is a blurry blob, and the Neon sky is a flat purple gradient.
Vehicles use photogrammetry-style textures that look rich but blotchy, like smeared baked albedo. Ground and logs use untextured flat colors with no roughness variation.
Mixed fidelity: detailed scanned trams, locomotives and trucks sit beside primitive logs, cylinder lily pads and low-poly trees. The frog model is decent but its texture is mushy.
Upper half is crammed with overlapping vehicles across many lanes, making a cluttered wall with poor lane readability. Huge oversized logs crop the bottom edge.
Low behind-the-player chase angle rather than a clean elevated view. Far lanes stack and occlude each other; the frog sits at roughly 15% of the frame.
Mild bloom on the sun and a warm grade in Emberline. Little color grading or AO elsewhere; Meadow looks washed and grey-blue.
Small dust puffs on hops. The frog's pose looks stiff mid-hop, and vehicles packed bumper to bumper suggest crude spawning.
Clean score panel, coin and best pills, level badge and controls hint. The floating '+10 coin' / 'Quick Play' toast text is small and has a soft shadow.

nextChange.change: raise shadow strength toward the look target and pull the key light to an angle that throws visible contact shadows
